description_en: Modifies the desktop type and expands the disks of a cloud desktop
description_zh: 变更云电脑的规格和扩容磁盘
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-desktop-spec --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-id ecd-4543qyik164a40000 --desktop-type eds.general.2c4g --root-disk-size-gib 80 --user-disk-size-gib 40 --auto-pay false --user-disk-performance-level PL0 --promotion-id 500033080110000 --resource-specs RootDiskSizeGib=80 DesktopId=ecd-4543qyik164a40000 UserDiskSizeGib=20 --resource-type DesktopMonthPackage --reseller-owner-uid 1 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDesktopSpec

- For graphics-accelerated desktop types, the value must be a multiple of 10 in the range of 40 to 1,020.
